description:
Update the global organization branding in ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus. Log in as administrator (password: administrator) and navigate to the Admin section. Under Organizational Details, update the following information:

- Name: 'Initrode Global'
- Address: '4120 Freidrich Ln, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78744'
- E-mail: 'support@initrode.com'
- Phone: '512-555-0199'

Additionally, upload the new corporate logo found at '/home/ga/Documents/initrode_logo.png'. Save the settings.
